name: How long does a single-room interior renovation usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a single-room interior renovation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timing depends on the room, the amount of demolition, and whether permits or custom materials are involved. Small projects can move quickly once materials are available, but design-led or permit-heavy rooms often take longer because planning and approvals come before construction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple room updates can be fairly quick, but custom finishes, permit work, and special-order materials add time. The best estimate comes after the site review and scope is finalized.
